scope_note: Categories support education and future research. A fee is not automatically unlawful, deceptive, or negotiable merely because it appears in this taxonomy.

categories.label: Mandatory disclosed fee
categories.definition: A required charge identified before commitment or payment.
categories.auto_detection: possible when line item and disclosure context are present
categories.limitations: legal sufficiency depends on jurisdiction and transaction context

categories.label: Recurring fee
categories.definition: A charge that repeats on a schedule or while an account remains active.
categories.auto_detection: often detectable from frequency and amount patterns

categories.label: Cancellation or early-termination fee
categories.definition: A charge triggered by ending a service, contract, or commitment.

categories.label: Administrative or processing fee
categories.definition: A charge described as handling, processing, convenience, or administration.
categories.limitations: label alone does not establish wrongdoing

categories.label: Price escalation or variable charge
categories.definition: A term allowing a price or fee to change based on time, usage, index, or discretion.
actions: ask when and how price changes
categories.auto_detection: possible when trigger and amount language are explicit
categories.limitations: interpretation is context and jurisdiction dependent

categories.label: Duplicate or unclear charge
categories.definition: A repeated, bundled, or insufficiently described line item requiring reconciliation.
categories.limitations: requires complete records and human confirmation
